extraction.notes: Q1 2024 three-month column used. Subtotals verified: 26,402 + adjustments = 18,941 FFO; 18,941 + adjustments = 19,649 Core FFO; 19,649 + adjustments = 22,571 AFFO. Diluted shares 26,354 reproduces reported per-share figures (18,941/26,354=0.72; 19,649/26,354=0.75; 22,571/26,354=0.86). The reconciliation starts at net income of $26,402, which differs from net income attributable to common stockholders of $26,298 shown in the financial summary; the reconciliation's starting line was used. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex; the Q1 2024 recurring capitalized maintenance figure of $2,919 from the Historical Capital Expenditures table is recorded. The reconciliation's Core FFO line-item 'Casualty-related expenses/(recoveries)' and 'Casualty losses (gains)' are both categorized as casualty.
